where: Tinderwick indoors — the apprentice's home and the village store
mood: Embers banked low — the hometown lullaby gone indoors at night, a 6/8 sway by the coals, homesick and safe.
_note: 6/8 written as 3 quarter-beats per bar at quarter = 80 (the classic spec's tempo; 2.25 s/bar).
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
A minor resolving to C major
soft pulse-wave lead with a sighing melody
round soft synth bass breathing on the dotted pulse
intimate small-room cottage interior by a banked fire, warm and a little homesick

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {stepping in from the cold: a soft music-box arpeggio rolls down like a door easing shut, one celesta glint, then the lead's first sighing notes settle into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lullaby melody in A minor, rocking in 6/8 over the music-box; the hopeful rising lift undershoots and lingers, more sigh than leap; clear and hummable}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again, now with a soft flute counter-line woven under it and the strings a little warmer, like the fire catching again}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the melody turns to warm C major and moves higher, a cosy memory of daytime, music-box and celesta brighter, then sways back down toward the minor}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lullaby returns in A minor, fuller and calm; the last bar sways straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
